remaining_gaps: Recover generator only up to ONE POSITIVE GLOBAL CLOCK; no absolute rates or entropy production per physical time. Equilibrium symmetric barriers are blind, and bridges/articulation blocks can leave distinct scales. Sufficient cycle/biconnectivity assumptions are NOT a full necessity characterization of constrained physical inverse problems. No uniform finite-data guarantee or experimental capability/advantage. The earlier audited blind theorem with 3-vertex-connected selected graph remains valid HISTORY, but graphic-matroid recognition, Whitney reconstruction and row-permutation alignment are UNNECESSARY. Known labels: solve 1^T K=0,K pi=0,K d_e parallel b_e; cycle-ray rigidity gives K=cW, normalize -tr K=1 and generator sign. Unknown labels: scan extrema of h_i=d_i/pi_i=pi_prime_i/pi_i-1 then the SAME labelled linear system. Exact rational divisions/comparisons/Gaussian elimination have polynomial bit cost. Finite symmetric-control compatibility still requires D=(V_ba e_a-V_ab e_b)^T pi_prime !=0 and t=1-alpha/D>0,t!=1 for Vd=alpha(e_b-e_a); invariant under V scaling. For IID stationary samples N/condition, eta=sqrt(log(2n(m+1)/delta)/(2N)); mixing, settling, effective independent sample count and physical controls are paid. Corrected endpoint ratio error B=2eta/r+2eta/r^2 if eta<r/2,r=min pi, and endpoint gap g>2B plus arithmetic error suffices. Sharper eta(1+R)/(pi_min-eta) uses R=max pi_prime/pi. Rate reconstruction additionally pays its nonzero constraint singular gap, small-rate positivity and division sensitivity; old matroid rank-oracle margins are not needed for corrected acquisition.
